facts: Real popup rows have pointerdown/up/move registrations, aria-disabled=false and tabindex=0. ActiveElement becomes body after keyboard open. Two unchanged source runs retained; no production fix was attempted between them.
cause: Capture-phase lowerMouse queues adoption for synthetic original lower gesture, after synchronous keyboard adoption. Re-adopting same current menu restores/removes focusability on the focused TR and loses Chromium focus.
repair: Identity guard retains already-valid same instance/opener/request ownership; queued mouse observer cannot re-adopt keyboard-owned menu. No callback replacement or forced action.
